findings.title: Sensitive operation answers anonymous callers
findings.description: Requests with no credential at all got a 2xx response from an endpoint that returns sensitive data or changes state.
findings.detail: POST /reservation (frontend) returned 2xx to 15 request(s) without a token
findings.recommendation: Add authentication to POST /reservation in frontend.
mitigation: Require a verified token on this operation in the service itself, not only at the gateway.
Reject requests without Authorization with 401 before any business logic runs.
Add a test that calls the endpoint anonymously and expects 401.

findings.title: Credential passed in the URL query string
findings.description: A query parameter name looks like a token, key or password. URLs end up in logs, proxies and browser history.
findings.detail: GET /user (frontend) takes password in the query string
findings.recommendation: Move password out of the URL of GET /user.
mitigation: Send credentials in the Authorization header or the request body, never in the URL.
Strip or mask the parameter in access logs while migrating clients.

findings.title: Credential passed in the URL query string

evidence: query params: customerName, hotelId, inDate, number, outDate, password, username
findings.recommendation: Move password out of the URL of POST /reservation.
mitigation: Send credentials in the Authorization header or the request body, never in the URL.
Strip or mask the parameter in access logs while migrating clients.

findings.title: Bulk sensitive data exposure
findings.description: An endpoint returns a list of records with personal or financial fields, and it is either reachable without a token or not documented, so nobody reviewed what it hands out.
findings.detail: POST /profile.Profile/GetProfiles (profile) returns a list with pii fields
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
findings.owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
findings.recommendation: Reduce fields and require an admin role on /profile.Profile/GetProfiles.
mitigation: Return only the fields the client needs (response schema / DTO, not the raw record).
Paginate with a hard maximum and require an admin role for bulk export.
Log every bulk export with the caller identity.

findings.title: Service-to-service call accepted without credentials
findings.description: Another microservice calls this endpoint without any credential and it succeeds, so any pod that can reach it can do the same (no zero-trust between services).
findings.detail: search -> POST /geo.Geo/Nearby (geo) with no credential
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
evidence: no mTLS enforced for geo (no STRICT PeerAuthentication or mesh injection)
findings.recommendation: Require service identity (mTLS or a service token) on /geo.Geo/Nearby in geo.
mitigation: Authenticate workloads to each other: mTLS through a service mesh, or signed service tokens.
Authorize per caller: only order-service may call /charge, for example.
findings.snippet:
# Istio: require mTLS and allow only order-service
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
spec:
  rules:
  - from:
    - source: {principals: ["cluster.local/ns/shoplite/sa/order-service"]}
